design.api: additive new module brute/api/certify16e.py (certify/16e, Certifier16E). It reuses the frozen certify/16d instance (H16D, Pool16D, CCounted) through imports only and replaces only the per-call solve: a call runs solve_limited with conf_budget(min(C, conflicts left in the case)); if the result is unknown because of the chunk cap and the case budget is not spent, the SAME solver is called again with the same assumptions and a fresh chunk, until it answers, the case budget B is spent, or a wall guard fires. The wall guard (30 s per call, 600 s per case, as certify/16d) is checked between chunks only, so a chunk boundary is a conflict count, never a clock reading. A parameter max_chunks (default unlimited; 1 = certify/16d behaviour) is public. Host-agnostic: no I/O, threads, subprocess or os in brute/; frozen certify16d.py, certify16.py and certify14 are not edited
design.cap_rule: fixed NOW, before any 049 data, from sealed 048 results only (Exact): chunk C = 50000 (the 048 value, 0 guard firings in 048, max call 7.79 s); B16 = 1500000 and B20 = 1000000 (the 048 values). Not calibrated, not tuned. Reason (Inferred): 048 showed C 50000 wall-free on this host, and 047 decided 10/12 with calls up to 294000 conflicts, which B16 now allows as 6 chunks
